clips.prompt: /flashcard Using only the attached chapter, create a compact three-card recall activity on tokens, context and probability versus truth. Use a self-contained inline worksheet widget in this ChatGPT response, independently usable from its shared link. Show one card at a time, Reveal/Hide answer, Previous/Next, I remember this/Needs practice, reviewed progress, summary, Review missed cards and Reset. Cite chapter sections and pages in each answer. Disable and visibly dim both rating buttons until the current answer is revealed, with “Reveal the answer before rating.” Count each card once; changing a rating replaces it; navigation preserves state. Missed-only review hides answers for fresh recall. When its last missed card becomes remembered, automatically show the updated summary; never show 0 of 0 or a fallback card. Reset everywhere clears ratings, reveals and review modes, returning to Question 1 with 0 of 3 reviewed. Use inline response controls rather than an account-saved deck, file or external app. Use English learner-facing text only.
